annotations.title: Draft a claim or dispute letter

description: Fill a fixed claim or dispute letter from the caller-supplied facts and the scores from a validity screen. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/claims/dispute-draft Keywords: when preparing an insurance claim, purpose, claimant, insurer, policy number, claim number, incident date, amount, facts, claim validity score, risk of denial percentage, matched exclusions, draft text, draft_text, completeness score.

claim_number.description: claim number, string, length 1 to 80. Optional.

claim_validity_score.description: claim validity score, number, from 0 to 100. Optional.

policy_number.description: policy number, string, length 1 to 80. Optional.

purpose.description: purpose, string, one of claim, dispute. Required.

risk_of_denial_percentage.description: risk of denial percentage, number, from 0 to 100. Optional.

name: claims_dispute-draft
title: Draft a claim or dispute letter
